how: Scenario 1, point 3. `no-instrument.toml` defines no instrument, so `visa.open` of SIM::DMM0 fails after the timeout of the open, the `timeout: 2 s` of the program, with `visa.resource_not_found`, code -1073807343 (libs/visa/simulation.md 1 and 6): the clock ends at 2000 ms and no session is opened. Its origin is the node `dmm`, line 14 of `examples/check_voltage.lcf`, named as commands.md 5 names the node of an origin (its first output), with the path from the root of the project (tests/acceptance/README.md). In `scpi.query_f64`, which runs its body, `visa.query` and `string.to_f64` are skipped (spec 7.2), so nothing is sent and `raw` is 0.0; `voltage` is then 0 V, written `0.0 V` (spec 7.2, default values; commands.md 5, a float keeps `.0`, as its example `0.0 V`). `visa.close`, `always`, runs and passes on the error it received (spec 7.2); `err = e3` holds it, so the status is `error` and `error` repeats it (spec 8.2, commands.md 7). `handle e2` yields `Verdict.Error` (spec 12). `instruments` is left out: the documents do not say whether a run whose simulation defines no resource gives an empty list or no field.
